notes.title: Please wait for next release
notes.content:
Hello, racers.
This is developer of pocket car.
Here is announcement for you.

We are considering about unrelease the game til uploading complete game that is modified below problems, like adding languages(first may be english), supporting windows mr, server issues and so on.

Apologize to your expectations and thank you for your feedbacks.
We will be back soon with complete game.
